neighbours.label: a split word-initial fragment 'ex' or 'w' (ex|otic, w|ondrous, w|obble) when the word is broken into pieces
fire: Physicists created “exotic” states of matter in the cold lab.
The project led to wondrous discoveries in deep sea biology.
Make sure there is no "wobble" when you stand on one leg.
Companies can sell the "excess" credits to other firms.
The old fisherman had a wizened face and a quiet laugh.
The garden had a whimsical charm that delighted every visitor.
Patients described "excessive" thirst during the hot summer.
The table had a slight wobbly leg that annoyed the guests.
quiet: Physicists created strange states of matter in the cold lab.
The project led to amazing discoveries in deep sea biology.
Make sure there is no "sway" when you stand on one leg.
Companies can sell the "spare" credits to other firms.
The old fisherman had a lined face and a quiet laugh.
The garden had a playful charm that delighted every visitor.
Patients described "intense" thirst during the hot summer.
The table had a slightly uneven leg that annoyed the guests.

notes: Card: 'ex' x8, ' w' x9, 'w' x5 as fragments of split words (often after a quote mark). Tokenization of fire words not checked beforehand.
